findings: DESIGN NOTE (draft, not a paper claim; source: draft material commented out in these.tex (l.3560–3677), not part of the thesis): the draft's third item (these.tex:3574) asks only that H maps rays to rays, while the draft's arguments for the suspension proposition (these.tex:3667, '(phi_p g phi_p^-1)(phi_i(x), r) = (g phi_i(x), r)') and for the analyticity lemma (these.tex:3611) use that phi_p g phi_p^-1 also PRESERVES THE RADIUS r. Read literally, without such a hypothesis, the cone charts phi_p^-1 o susp(phi_i) are not a (G,X)-atlas (GX.celestial_counterexample, BBS-Celestial) and the draft's lemma fails (GX.lem_analytique_counterexample); these counterexamples motivate the corrected definition. GX.ConicStructure (phi_p o h = susp(h|X_p) o phi_p on U cap h^-1 U) is A SUFFICIENT corrected form, not the minimal one: the weaker 'for each h in H some g_h in G with phi o g_h = susp(h.) o phi' (a radial lift) also serves the argument of these.tex:3667 and is a candidate minimal hypothesis for the author; it coincides with radius preservation (g_h = h) when G is contained in Isom. Not formalized; a later round may generalise ConicStructure to it.

DESIGN NOTE: radius preservation is restrictive: GX.ConicStructure.eq_of_tendsto_pow shows no RADIUS-PRESERVING conic structure exists when H contains an element contracting some orbit to p (e.g. a linear map with an eigenvalue in ]0,1[); for BBS's group G = Isom_0(E^{1,2}) with H = G_p = SO_0(1,2) this is GX.isEmpty_conicStructure_nullIsom0_stabilizer (BBS-Affine). This says nothing about the draft's ray-only notion nor about the radial-lift variant.
questions: BBS-Q2: the stabiliser is a parameter H; is the intended default the full stabiliser (the draft's choice) or the pointwise stabiliser of a ray (BBS)? Both are instances.

findings: Continuity of the induced action (not stated in the draft) is proved for a conic structure: GX.ConicStructure.continuousConstSMul.
Uniqueness of the induced action (any action making pi o phi equivariant is it) is proved: GX.ConicChart.linkAction_unique.

labels.label: draft:lem_analytique

hypotheses.paper: a conic structure (the commented-out draft's ray condition)
hypotheses.note: certified for the corrected notion GX.ConicStructure (radius preserved), which is what the draft's argument (these.tex:3611, 'les actions de g et h sur U x R+ sont egales') uses; for it, (H, L) is analytic (isAnalyticAction) and rigid from rigid (isRigidAction), no sorry. The draft's ray-only wording is not the notion certified: read literally the draft's lemma fails (design note)
ContinuousConstSMul G X and IsAnalyticAction G X (IsRigidAction G X for the rigidity half)

findings: DESIGN NOTE (draft, not a paper claim; source: draft material commented out in these.tex (l.3560–3677), not part of the thesis): the draft's lemma (these.tex:3606), read literally with the ray condition only, fails; counterexample motivating the radius hypothesis of GX.ConicStructure: GX.lem_analytique_counterexample (Affine.lean): (G,X) = (Aff(V), V), analytic (faithful and rigid, proved), p = 0, G_p = GL(V), phi = the inverse of the sphere map (sigma, r) -> r sigma (GX.affineConic). Linear maps send rays to rays, so the draft's ray condition holds (GX.affineConic_isRayCompatible); the induced action is the normalised action on S(V); the homothety 2.id in G_p is not 1 but acts trivially on S(V) (proved via GX.ConicChart.dir_smul_linkAction), so (G_p, X_p) is not faithful, hence not analytic. A corrected form proved: for a radius-preserving conic structure (GX.ConicStructure), (H, L) is analytic (isAnalyticAction) and rigid from rigid (isRigidAction). Under the ray condition alone faithfulness fails; whether rigidity alone survives is not settled.

kb_proposals: GX.Susp.dir (Quotient.out a).1 is a TOTAL projection susp -> Sigma equal to pi off O (dir_mk_of_pos); every point is mk (dir a, r a) (mk_dir_r) and two points are equal iff same dir and same r (eq_of_dir_eq_of_r_eq): use these instead of case splits on representatives.

The topology of GX.Susp makes the balls {r < eps} a basis at O, so the image of ANY neighbourhood of the apex meets EVERY ray (ConicChart.exists_mem_dir_eq) - this is what makes the draft's induced action well defined; it would fail for a 'conic' chart onto a non-uniform neighbourhood.

A conic structure onto the whole cone (IsFull) is H-invariant on all of U (ConicStructure.map_smul_of_isFull, real induction along rays with IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_mem_nhdsWithin); this is what the cone-chart compatibility needs at every radius.
